# CANDIDATE: LIVE_PRICE_FIRST_BAR_TRIGGER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The live price first bar trigger aims to capture the initial market imbalance at the open by entering on the first bar that breaks the premarket high or low with confirmation. This edge exists because the first 5 minutes often see widened spreads and inefficient pricing, allowing for alpha capture when price breaks premarket extremes with follow-through.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the first RTH bar (9:30-9:35 ET) closes above the premarket high (for calls) or below the premarket low (for puts) with a minimum range of 0.10% and volume above 20-bar average, enter at the next bar open. Exit: Standard chart-stop (rejected level ± $0.50 buffer), TP1 at +50% premium, runner, chandelier profit-lock, and 15:50 ET time stop.
